transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I… I’m here because my mind keeps going blank. At work, I’ll be looking at the road-closure forms, or even holding the stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I can’t remember the steps. Things I’ve done for years. It’s been… hard.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… mostly down. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, kind of hollow sadness in my chest. Like the day’s already gone wrong before I even get out of bed.
Have you ever had a period of time before when you felt this way—like you were really down or hopeless—for more than two weeks?
Yeah… it’s been longer than that. I guess… about a year and a couple months now. The heavy feeling and hopelessness, it hasn’t really let up.
Have you had episodes of feeling this way more than once before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this kind of depression?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had bad stretches before, but I don’t know if they were like this. This one feels like it’s just… stayed.
Can you recall if you've had other times in your life where you felt down or hopeless for a period of time, before this current episode started?
I don’t know… I remember feeling low before, but this current thing is what stands out. Most mornings it’s that heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already ruined before I even get up.

Before this current period of feeling down and hopeless, can you recall having another time in your life when you felt this way for a while, and then it got better for a couple of months or more before coming back again?
I’m not sure. I can’t really separate it like that. What I know is… lately, most mornings I wake up with this heavy, empty sadness, like the day’s already bad before I even get out of bed.
Before this current stretch of feeling down and hopeless, can you remember a time when you felt this way for a while, and then things got better for a few months or more before getting bad again?
I don’t really know about it getting better for months. I just know lately… most mornings I wake up with this hollow, heavy sadness, like the day’s already ruined before I even get out of bed.

Before this current period of feeling down and hopeless, can you remember having another time when you felt this way for a while, and then things got better for several months before getting bad again?

I… I don’t really remember it in chunks like that. I just know most mornings now I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness in my chest, like the day’s already ruined before I even get my feet on the floor.

Before this current episode of feeling down and hopeless that’s lasted over a year, can you remember having another distinct time when you felt this way for at least two weeks, and then things got better for a while—like several months—before getting bad again?
I don’t really know. I can’t pick out a separate time like that… where it got better for months and then came back. It all kind of blurs together for me.
